outcome_status_at_freeze: no new follow-up PPL outcome exists or has been read

frozen_scientific_configuration.calibration: seed0 direct-N16; 64 OpenWebMath plus 64 CodeParrot sequences; 512 tokens
frozen_scientific_configuration.scope: non-head Linear weights only; excludes lm_head, embeddings, norms, and KV cache

dose_response.source_set: exact reconstructed k=3 CE-and-KL conjunction, required to match the frozen primary map tile-for-tile
dose_response.rank: stable descending -max(U_CE,U_KL), with ascending flat tile index as tie break
dose_response.remainder: retain first 8*floor(n_stratum/8) ranked tiles; record each excluded weakest remainder tile
dose_response.allocation: split retained ordered tiles into eight contiguous equal-count bins per stratum; bin01 strongest, bin08 weakest
dose_response.maps: for every bin, group-only and full-conjunction-minus-bin
invariants: equal tile counts in every stratum
bin union plus recorded remainder equals frozen conjunction

objective_ablation.conjunction: U_CE < 0 and U_KL < 0; exact frozen primary anchor
objective_ablation.ce_matched_k: within each conjunction module quota, lowest U_CE among CE-pass tiles; stable flat-index ties
objective_ablation.kl_matched_k: within each conjunction module quota, lowest U_KL among KL-pass tiles; stable flat-index ties
objective_ablation.random_matched_k: SHA-256 keyed order with seed 20260917 from the union of CE-pass or KL-pass candidates, using each conjunction module quota
objective_ablation.natural_interpretation: descriptive complete rules with unequal counts
objective_ablation.matched_interpretation: per-stratum equal budgets isolate objective information

mistral_veto_completion.source: the outcome-blind class and controls frozen by the completed mechanism map run
mistral_veto_completion.selection: strongest approving KL margins up to floor(0.25*conjunction_count)
mistral_veto_completion.matching: exact module and one of five global approving-KL-margin quantile bins; disjoint common support; seed 20260917
mistral_veto_completion.required_reproduction: newly reconstructed masks must match both previously frozen, unevaluated Mistral masks tile-for-tile

conditions: artifact hashes match the 3154-entry mechanism manifest

optional_qwen27b.reason: optional within-family scale replication is not required for any frozen gate; the 24-hour budget is reserved for complete required evidence and audit

statistics.seed_derivation: first 64 bits of SHA-256 over colon-separated seed root and endpoint label
statistics.unit: paired natural document cluster for C4 and article cluster for WikiText
statistics.p_value: finite Monte Carlo plus-one, using centered bootstrap noise

holm_families.A_development: 2 development models * 2 corpora * 8 signed dose statistics = 32
holm_families.A_validation: 1 validation model * 2 corpora * 8 signed dose statistics = 16
holm_families.C_mistral: 2 corpora * (2 mean contrasts + q90/q95/q99, regression probability, worst-cluster differences) = 14

dose_statistics.joint_bootstrap: all eight observed bin effects recomputed from the same resampled clusters
dose_statistics.calibration_weights: inverse marginal variance of the 10000 joint bootstrap bin-effect estimates, then held fixed across regression replicates

pooled_analysis.standardize: predictor and observed effect separately within model and corpus
pooled_analysis.model: OLS slope with model and corpus fixed-effect indicators
pooled_analysis.interpretation: sensitivity only; per-model panels remain primary

frozen_gates.dose_response: for each of CE-sum and margin predictors, all four development Spearman estimates have the expected direction and at least three of four paired-bootstrap 95% CIs exclude zero in that direction; overall pass requires both predictor gates
frozen_gates.objective_conjunction: for each CE-matched and KL-matched comparison, single-objective minus conjunction is positive in all four development endpoints and Holm-significant in at least three; overall pass requires both
frozen_gates.objective_information_vs_random: for each scored matched selector separately, selector-minus-random is negative in all four development endpoints and Holm-significant in at least three
frozen_gates.mistral_veto_symmetry: actual add-back is worse than conjunction and matched random in both corpora and all four mean contrasts are Holm-significant within C-Mistral
frozen_gates.negative_result_policy: never change k, bins, models, endpoints, seeds, matching, or gates after outcomes

gpu_policy.co_tenancy_action: stop only this campaign container at a safe boundary, mark invalid, retain evidence, rerun

claim_boundaries.qwen4b: predeclared high-response/outlier development case; never removed from primary per-model reporting
claim_boundaries.mistral7b: one-shot analysis validation, not a fully independent confirmatory family
claim_boundaries.dose_response: aggregate group ranking only; no individual-tile causality
prohibited: reliable individual-tile causal signs or magnitudes
